description: Your dog Maxie was hit by a car and needs emergency surgery. Open /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/campaign_notes.txt to read the messy notes from the emergency vet visit. Create a professional crowdfunding campaign document at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/maxie_campaign.docx with: (1) a campaign title mentioning Maxie and the emergency, (2) a story section (2-3 paragraphs) describing what happened, (3) a budget breakdown TABLE showing all itemized costs from the notes (initial $2,800 paid, plus 7 additional line items totaling $6,200 needed), (4) correct total calculations ($9,000 total, $6,200 still needed), and (5) a brief thank you/closing. Save the document (Ctrl+S).
